card.name: Final syllable of tiotropium
card.fires_on: The closing "ium" in the drug name tiotropium (tiotrop-ium) in inhaler labels. It weakly also fires on the final "UM" of POTASSIUM.

modes.label: Tiotropium ending
modes.description: The last piece "ium" completing tiotropium, often before bromide, in inhalation product text.
modes.example: 10 OVERDOSAGE High doses of tiotrop<<ium>> may lead to anticholinergic signs

modes.label: Potassium ending
modes.description: The final "UM" of POTASSIUM in capitals, a weaker match.
modes.example: POTASSIUM EXCHANGE. FOR EVERY 3 SODIUMS INSIDE THE CELL IS EXCHANGED FOR 2 POTASSI<<UM>> IN EXTRAC

card.plain: It marks the end of the drug name tiotropium once the name is almost spelled out.
